messages:
deploy-bot: Heads-up: Maintenance scheduled for Dedicated EU GPU pool tonight 2026-02-12 00:00-01:00 UTC. Kernel + runtime security patch. Expected impact: short spikes in errors/latency for subset of requests. We will apply model pins and have a rollback plan.
rachel-support: Creating statuspage entry and customer email. Please confirm wording and ops runbook links. Will send at 23:30 UTC unless changes.
jay-eng: Confirmed. We'll apply pin to stable model variants (pin to model-serve v1.7.2) 10m prior. Health checks every 30s. Fallback image v1.6 kept ready.
emma-sr: Draft for status page (short):

```
Component: Dedicated EU GPU pool
Status: Under Maintenance
Start: 2026-02-12 00:00 UTC
ETA: ~1 hour
Details: We're applying a security patch to the runtime and kernel on a subset of Dedicated EU nodes. You may see brief increases in latency or error rates for some requests. We have pinned model versions and will roll back if needed.
Action: No action required. Contact eu-support@redwood.ai for urgent issues.
```

rachel-support: Looks good. Two edits: add a one-line note for customers on reserved capacity about contacting their account rep to request a maintenance hold, and include the rollback runbook link for internal ops only.

emma-sr: Updated statuspage snippet with opt-out line and removed runbook link from public text.

jay-eng: Ops flags (internal): {pin=true, health_check_interval=30s, throttle_new_sessions_on_warmup=true}. Rollback triggers: sustained error_rate>3% for 10m OR p95 latency >1.5s for 10m. Rollback will switch to v1.6 and purge ephemeral KV caches as needed.

carla-cs: Email draft for customers (short):

"Hi — We're planning a brief maintenance on our Dedicated EU inference pool on 2026-02-12 00:00–01:00 UTC to apply a security patch. Some requests may experience temporary latency increases or errors. We've pinned stable model variants and have a rollback plan in place. No action required. If you need to opt out or have reserved capacity concerns, contact your account rep or eu-support@redwood.ai. — Redwood Inference Ops"

rachel-support: I'll queue this for 23:30 UTC send and post the status page update now. On-call: @jay-eng primary, @emma-sr backup.

opsbot: Reminder set: 2026-02-11 23:50 UTC — pre-window checklist and pin verification.

jay-eng: I'll be monitoring metrics and will post live updates here. If rollback happens, I'll open ticket #RB-2026-212 and post the link.

rachel-support: If anyone expects customer-critical workloads in that hour, please DM eu-support to arrange a maintenance hold. Otherwise moving this thread to ops for live updates at window start. :white_check_mark:
